Both URLs are specific to the stated upstream and use HTTPS, which is appropriate. The `pkgver` is hardcoded as `0.1.41`, so no dynamic version fetching occurs. There is no code in the global scope or in a `pkgver()` function that would execute harmful commands during sourcing. The `source` and `source_x86_64` arrays only contain straightforward HTTPS URLs with no command substitution or shell injection. No `prepare()`, `build()`, or `package()` steps are executed under `--noprepare` and `--nobuild`, so the `package()` function is irrelevant for this gate.

Thus, running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` will safely download the sources without executing any untrusted code or performing any dangerous operations.
</details>
